stories.headline: Asylum seekers told rape and harassment illegal in UK in new Home Office booklet
stories.description: The nine-page booklet covers issues including respect in public, sex and consent, and gender equality.

stories.headline: Are Hormuz ships more willing to defy Iran or the US? What data shows
stories.description: Most ships are trying to mask identities while trying to cross the strait. But more seem scared of Iran than of the US.

stories.headline: Vaccine breakthrough stops cancer returning in trial
stories.description: A new jab extended the length of time patients were cancer free, but it is unclear for how long.

stories.headline: Over 200,000 people newly displaced in Sudan’s Kordofan as fighting rages
stories.description: UN warns of surging displacement in Kordofan as power and water infrastructure come under attack in El Obeid.

stories.headline: Bangladesh holds presidential election in first contested vote in 35 years
stories.description: BNP’s Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is pitted against ex-army officer Oli Ahmed, nominee of Jamaat-led 11-party alliance.
